title: DiagnoseRequest
description: Core asks the engine what a session's passes say about the car (POST /diagnose).

passes.description: The session's valid passes with their features.

speed_class.description: Band of the corner's minimum speed.

metrics.description: Metric id to value; null when it could not be measured on this pass.

items.description: The changeable items of the car's setup; empty when the session has no setup data.

items.title: DiagnoseItem
items.description: One changeable setup item, as the agent read it from the setup menu.

role.description: What the item does (arb, wing, camber, ...); empty when unknown.

axle.description: F or R when the item belongs to one axle; empty otherwise.

shown_scale.description: Raw value times this is what the menu shows; negative when the car stores the value inverted.

value.description: Raw value on the setup an experiment would start from.
